SMTO-CFG-0049 — SMTO can't start because its schedule history limit is too low

GUID: d703c7c1-79b2-4f59-9db4-00b7acc40e2f
Slug: config-agent-events-max-run-history-must-be
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • SMTO stopped while starting because the number of past Schedule runs and notifications it keeps is set to zero or less. Your conversations, Schedules and settings were not changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Find where SMTO is started (the terminal command, a startup script or the service settings) and look for a setting named AOR_AGENT_EVENTS_MAX_RUN_HISTORY. This history limit comes only from that startup setting.
  2. Delete that setting to use SMTO's usual value of 5000, or change it to a positive whole number such as 5000. SMTO uses the number to decide how many past Schedule runs to keep, so it must be at least 1.
  3. Start SMTO again from the same place where you changed the setting. SMTO reads this setting only when it starts, and only from where it is launched.

What success looks like

  • The startup screen reaches Ready and the Schedules page opens.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who installed SMTO, and tell them which startup settings you changed. Don't change other settings that start with AOR_ to get past this error.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Settings validation rejected agent_events_max_run_history (environment variable AOR_AGENT_EVENTS_MAX_RUN_HISTORY) because it is zero or negative.

What this means

  • agent_events_max_run_history is zero or negative during application settings validation. Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.

Why this can happen

  • agent_events_max_run_history is zero or negative during application settings validation.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect this history-count setting rather than event polling time or task output limits.

How to fix it

  • Unset AOR_AGENT_EVENTS_MAX_RUN_HISTORY or set it to a positive integer (default 5000) in the Server's launch environment, then restart. It sizes the event store's settled-run history (and notification history, minimum 100); it is unrelated to the event polling interval and task output limits.
  • Set agent_events_max_run_history to a positive supported history count.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended positive event-history bound passes settings validation.

What not to do

  • Do not change an unrelated timeout, budget or policy. Check whether the named setting applies only to a new task.

Technical notes

  • Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
